component: Lined in an immense layer of ice, the cavern expands outward into chamber after endless chamber. Stalactites, nearly three times the height of a mature Gor'Tog, stretch from ceiling to floor like glassy assassin's daggers, threatening to fall at a moment's notice. Along the northeastern wall, a curving stone passage rises upward at a steep angle, partially bathed in a pale illumination cast from some unknown source.

Carved into the icy stone, an expansive cavern winds its way downward into glimmering shadows far below. Broken bones are casually stacked against the slanted walls, the space between each pile cutting a narrow pathway down the midline of the dank chamber. The craggy fissure that splits the southern wall offers an obstructed view of the mountains beyond, the pristine snow catching the light, its pale blanket smoothing the harsh lines of the mountain's visage.
Obvious exits: southeast.

Imposing rock walls rise into the night sky, their suffocating closeness heightening the effects of nightfall. Spreading tendrils of darkness creep across the bottom of the chasm devouring the last remnants of day. A forbidding dark fissure, almost lost in the inky blackness, mars the rock face and plunges deep into the cold heart of the mountain.
Obvious paths: south.

Crushed between the sheer walls of the chasm, the winding mountain trail twists and turns without reason amidst piles of snow-covered boulders. Visibility, hampered by blinding clouds of wind-blown snow, leaves much to be desired. As soon as one massive drift of snow is conquered, another awaits around the next bend. The bitter cold of the gorge offers little warmth and comfort and the stone mountains glare icily down upon travelers.
Obvious paths: north, southwest.

Night covers the narrow gorge with an impenetrable veil of darkness. The inky blackness devours the remotest hint of shape or shadow, and nothing is distinguishable in the black void at the bottom of the chasm. Fragments of lose rock and ice dislodged by the winds plunge unseen into deep snow drifts with thunderous crashes.
Obvious paths: northeast, southwest, northwest.
